output_identity.why_by_construction: a state's value is a pure function of (s, width sequence from line, run, d); d cannot reach 0 on a whole-paragraph window because every line advances s; line collapses only when all later widths are bit-equal; the scan yields the same candidates in the same order with the same 1e-12 rule; rescue is entered only where the base panicked.
